title: BPW-2026-0629
text:
[BUREAU OF SANITATION]
BPW-2026-0629
CD ALL
PERSONAL SERVICES CONTRACT – SAMSARA, INC.
Recommending the Board:
APPROVE and forward this report with transmittals to the Mayor with the request that the Board of Public Works be authorized to execute a Personal Services Contract with Samsara, Inc. for Solid Resources Fleet Telematics And Service Confirmation Platform; and
AUTHORIZE the President or two members of the Board to execute the contract upon the Mayor’s authorization.
(W.O.: S06MSFTP)
summary: Sends a personal services contract with Samsara, Inc. for a fleet telematics and service confirmation platform for Solid Resources to the Mayor for approval.
